target_text: dw i'n teimlo fel taswn i ddim yn barod bore 'ma

target_text: كَيْفَ يَبْدو أَنْ تَسْتَيْقِظَ هُنا

target_text: It's like this today

known_text: kò dà bíi pé nǹkan kan lónìí
target_text: Does 'na ddim byd i weld heddiw

known_text: he's sick
